protocol_notes: hermetic generation: claude CLI cwd'd into twin tmp hosts; host B tree+prompt asserted free of the house name (HermeticityError aborts the run)
one identical generation prompt for both arms; the treatment lives in host files
symmetric no-<script> rule; native HTML capabilities allowed on both arms
capture stylesheet compiled with the generated arms as a Tailwind source (no purge bias)

alert.brief: A destructive alert 'Payment failed' with a description and a warning icon

app_shell.brief: An application shell: a collapsible sidebar with a Platform nav group (Dashboard active) and a main content area with a collapse toggle

artwork_carousel.brief: A three-slide artwork carousel with previous/next controls

button.brief: A destructive 'Delete account' button with a leading trash icon

card.brief: A plan card: title, description, a 'beta' badge, body copy, and a 'Learn more' link

chat_transcript.brief: A chat transcript: date divider, assistant message with an attachment and a quick reply, and a live 'thinking' status

command_palette.brief: A command palette: a search box filtering a grouped list of app commands (Suggestions: Calendar, Search Emoji, Calculator; Settings: Profile, Billing, Settings - with ⌘ shortcut hints), keyboard-first filter-then-activate

data_table.brief: A sortable, filterable invoices table: sorted by invoice number ascending, with a filter box and pagination

date_field.brief: A due-date field: a button showing the selected date that opens a calendar of selectable days

deferred_region.brief: A dashboard activity panel that loads only when scrolled into view, with a visible retry affordance when the fetch fails

dialog.brief: A settings dialog opened by a button, with a description and a confirm action

disclosure.brief: An FAQ accordion (one open at a time) plus a 'show advanced options' collapsible

empty_state.brief: A 'no projects yet' empty state: an icon tile, a title, a description, and create/import actions

filter_toolbar.brief: A filter toolbar: a search box with a leading icon and ⌘K hint, a sort dropdown, and a List/Grid view switch

floating.brief: The popper-consumer trio end-to-end: a 'Dimensions' popover behind an 'Open popover' button hosting a small form, an icon-only 'Add to library' control with a tooltip, and an '@nextjs' link enriched with a profile hover-card whose content lives at the link's destination

form_controls.brief: A notification settings panel: an 'Accept terms' checkbox staged for submit, an instant-effect 'Email alerts' switch, a bookmark toggle, an exclusive list/grid view switcher, a submitting digest-frequency choice, an 'Alert volume' slider, an 'Unsubscribe note' textarea, and a 6-digit 'Confirmation code' entry

form_field.brief: An email field labeled 'Work email', required, with a hint and the error 'can't be blank'

menu.brief: The menus family end-to-end: an app menubar (File/View), a row-actions dropdown menu behind an 'Options' button (account items, a checkbox preference, a destructive delete), and a right-click context menu on the row itself

mobile_sheet.brief: A bottom drawer for setting a daily activity goal: trigger, title, description, a Submit action, and a swipe handle

overlay.brief: A destructive 'Delete API key' confirmation that must be answered (alert dialog), plus a 'Filter results' panel sliding in from the right edge (sheet)

pagination.brief: Pagination for page 4 of 10, with a current-page marker

primitives.brief: A loading state: a labelled spinner, a skeleton row, a separator, and a ⌘K hint

scrollable_tags.brief: A bounded, scrollable list of 20 version tags in a 12rem box

searchable_select.brief: A labelled framework picker: a combobox-role control with a hidden form serialization opening a type-to-filter popup over Next.js/SvelteKit/Nuxt.js/Remix/Astro options

settings_tabs.brief: Account settings tabs (Account / Password / Notifications) with the first tab active and its panel visible

site_nav.brief: A site navigation bar: a Products dropdown of links, plus Pricing and Docs destinations

split_editor.brief: A two-pane resizable split (Files | Editor) with a draggable divider

table.brief: An invoices table with a caption, column headers, and a footer total

toast.brief: A notifications region hosting a 'Saved' success toast and a destructive 'Payment failed' toast with a 'Retry' action

upload_progress.brief: A determinate upload progress bar at 60%, with a visible label and value

user_directory.brief: A team directory: a breadcrumb trail (Home / Team / Directory), then a list of member rows - avatar, name, description, and a Message action

p2_widest_gaps.registered: gate pass-rate gap widest on a11y + design-slop

p3_blocks_signal.registered: raw_tailwind winning any composition axis is the Blocks signal
